limits: Only the bounded prompt/context slice is closed; the whole V1 plan is not complete.
Prepared metadata does not prove HTTP dispatch, acceptance, billing, provider completion, scientific validity or general research-efficiency gains.
Complete UTF-8 prompt size is not tokenizer count, HTTP request envelope size, whole-process memory usage or the sum of every legacy context input read.
Partial-read hashes are not hashes of unread full files; generated-context and digest hashes do not invent provenance for all underlying inputs.
Native hash-bound rules remain mandatory. Bare legacy empty-hash calls retain their missing-optional-rule behavior.
No cross-file global atomic snapshot, malicious in-process plugin isolation, generic filesystem defense or network exactly-once property is claimed.
Sidecar publication may succeed before a later fsync/readback fails; the cycle still refuses the provider, and sidecar presence is not execution proof.
No real provider, paid account, GPU training, production licensing, holdout task, online migration, main-branch merge or deployment was performed.
